the metal cutting process is a complex process of plastic deformation, which is related to many factors such as material properties, tool properties, cutting conditions and cutting parameters.

the cutting mechanism is a complex process in which material is extruded by cutting edge, sheared by the extrusion of tool flank face and the friction from cutting edge, and the extrusion and shearing are the main reasons for the formation of residual stress.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the cutting mechanism is a plastic deformation mechanism, and it is the extrusion and shearing of cutting edge that result in the formation of cutting layer, the cutting force, and the residual stress.
, the cutting process is an extrusion and shearing slip process, and the material in cutting layer and formed surface layer undergo cold plastic deformation, and the residual stress is formed.

the cutting process of workpiece material can be simulated by using the coupling method; the cutting process can be analyzed by using FEM and SPF; and the results can be used for the design of the cutting tool and cutting process.

the coupling method can be used to simulate the cutting process and analyze the cutting mechanisms.
